gen-gf-offside-gf-blinker: Offside's curves refuse to close, and its wide tracking gives each word a commanding, unhurried stride before Blinker steps in. Blinker, a plain sans, fills its lines with open, friendly lowercase.
gen-gf-offside-gf-carrois-gothic: Wide-spaced, commanding, and not one thick stroke in sight. Offside does its best work making statements with strokes of unchanging width, while Carrois Gothic, a sans-serif, excels at tall, open text.
gen-gf-offside-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads with a clear opening at the end of every curve and little gap between capitals and lowercase. Offside's unshaded, widely tracked letters add the commanding swagger that sets the two apart.
gen-gf-offside-gf-chocolate-classical-sa: Expressive from the first letter, Offside lays out its unclosed curves wide before Chocolate Classical Sans takes over the text. Its sizable lowercase and pen-drawn openings make paragraphs move along comfortably.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Friendly and open, with small letters nearly as tall as capitals, the body text reads smoothly. Hedvig Letters Sans can go a touch smaller without losing clarity, while Offside keeps its line unshaded.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-mysuru: Wide-tracked drama up top, then straight talk right underneath. Offside's open-ended curves lead, and Hind Mysuru, a sans, follows with lowercase pressed close to ascender height and unthinned lines.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hind-siliguri: Loud, wide, and level, with curves that never quite close. Hind Siliguri, a plain sans, hums softly along in constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle.
gen-gf-offside-gf-huninn: Commanding from the first wide-set letter. Offside holds that pose with unshaded curves left open, while Huninn, a sans-serif, brings crossbars as fat as its stems and lowercase near cap height.
gen-gf-offside-gf-karla: Wide-set and flat-toned, Offside lets its unclosed curves hang open like a statement nobody ever needs to repeat. Karla, a sans-serif, backs it up with stocky, gaping-open, friendly lowercase.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Offside's curves refuse to close, giving its wide-set letters a commanding, unshaded stance. And Noto Sans Adlam, a plain sans, keeps its curve endings well apart, so it can sit comfortably at a modest size.
